title: Affine depth-two hull of the actual finite etale pushforward
statement:
theorem affine_depth_two_pushforward_hull
    {L : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian L] (U : L.Opens)
    (hboundary : ∀ y : L, y ∉ U →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := L.presheaf.stalk y) (L.presheaf.stalk y))
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ U.toScheme) [IsFinite f] [Etale f]
    (V : L.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
    let g := f ≫ U.ι
    let B : L.CommAlgebraSheaf := Under.mk
      (⟨g.c⟩ : L.sheaf ⟶ (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward CommRingCat.{u} g.base).obj X.sheaf)
    let N := Modules.restrict B.toModule hV.fromSpec
    N.IsQuasicoherent ∧
      Module.Finite (L.presheaf.obj (op V)) Γ(N, ⊤) ∧
      (∀ x : Spec (L.presheaf.obj (op V)), hV.fromSpec x ∉ U →
        ∃ hfinite : Module.Finite ((Spec (L.presheaf.obj (op V))).presheaf.stalk x)
            (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) N.val.presheaf x),
          letI := hfinite
          (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth
            (R := (Spec (L.presheaf.obj (op V))).presheaf.stalk x)
            (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) N.val.presheaf x))

proof.text: On the affine chart Spec A, pull back f to the quasi-compact open preimage of U. Finite and etale are stable under this base change. Finite etale implies flat and locally finitely presented, so [lem-pc-finite-flat-pushforward-locally-free] applied to the unit module makes its direct image finite locally free. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-module-finite-presentation-extension] with ambient module zero and zero map to extend this module to a finitely presented module on Spec A, hence to a finite A-module M.

Form the genuine finite A-module N = Hom_A(Hom_A(M,A),A), and its associated module sheaf. Hom of finitely presented modules commutes with localization; finite locally free modules equal their double duals. Therefore its restriction to the open preimage of U is the original finite locally free module. No choice of a witness of a mere existence theorem is used to define the final global module: M is only an existential witness inside this proof.

A finite free presentation of Hom_A(M,A), after dualization, realizes N as the kernel of a map d between finite free A-modules. At a boundary stalk the base has depth at least two, transported across the open-immersion local-ring isomorphism. Choose a regular pair x,y there. If y*n=x*n' in N, regularity of y modulo x in the free source gives n=x*m. Since x*d(m)=0 and x acts injectively in the free target, d(m)=0. Thus m lies in N, proving injectivity of y on N/xN. Nakayama supplies properness when N is nonzero; a zero stalk has infinite depth. Finiteness follows from Noetherianity.

The associated sheaf has quasi-coherence and finite sections. Apply [lem-sbc-depth-two-hartogs-algebra-comparison] on the affine scheme to identify it with the actual composite direct image of the restricted finite etale cover. Restriction of a direct image to an open chart is the direct image of the base-changed cover, by the formula on sections. This identifies the module with the displayed N = B.toModule restricted along fromSpec. Transport the local properties across that isomorphism, including the scalar actions on sections and stalks.
